items.information: ### English # The competition has been cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. **Notice of Filming and Photography**: By being in attendance at WCA North American Championship 2020, competitors, spectators and other attendees consent to images of their likeness being captured and used by the World Cube Association, Rubik's Brand Ltd. and/or the North American Championship Organizing Committee in marketing materials and on social media platforms. ### Español # La competencia ha sido cancelada debido al brote de COVID-19. **Aviso de Grabación y Fotografía**: Al asistir al WCA North American Championship 2020; los competidores, espectadores y otros asistentes aceptan que imágenes de su persona pueden ser capturadas y utilizadas por la World Cube Association, Rubik's Brand Ltd. y/o el Comité Organizador del North American Championship en materiales de marketing y en plataformas de redes sociales. ### Français # La compétition a été annulée en raison du COVID-19. **Avis d'activités de tournage et de photographie**: En assistant au WCA North American Championship 2020, les compétiteurs, spectateurs et autres participants donnent leur consentement à ce que des images de leur ressemblance soient prises et utilisées par le World Cube Association, Rubik's Brand Ltd. et/ou le comité organisateur du Championnat Nord-Américain dans son matériel de marketing et sur les médias sociaux.

items.information: We are pleased to announce that the 2026 North American Championship will take place in Raleigh, North Carolina! This competition will serve as both the US National Championship and the North American Championship. Please note that **all spectators must have a spectator ticket**. Competitors will receive one free spectator ticket as part of their registration. Additional tickets can be purchased on [Ticketor](http://ticketor.com/cubingusa); limited quantities are available so make sure to purchase your spectator tickets early! All events have qualifying times; please refer to the [CubingUSA site](https://cubingusa.org/nac/2026/qualifying) for full details.
